findings.current: 除了他们，那里空无一人——又是一处空荡荡的美景胜地；在这里，我那一周已是第一百次纳闷：这段原始纯净的海岸怎么至今仍如此鲜为人知。
findings.proposed: 除了他们，那里空无一人——又是一处空荡荡的风景胜地；站在这里，我那一周里已经是第一百次纳闷：这段原始纯净的海岸怎么至今仍如此鲜为人知？
findings.reason: “我那一周已是第一百次纳闷”语序别扭，又缺“了/里”，读不顺；“美景胜地”不如通用的“风景胜地”（与 beauty spot 的释义一致）；冒号后是“怎么……”引出的直接疑问，句末用问号更自然。

findings.current: 有些日子，我们一路跋涉上坡，走到风车磨坊——如今那里是一座供两人入住的浪漫小屋——去饱览整个庄园乃至更远处的全景。
findings.proposed: 有几天，我们一路跋涉上坡，走到那座风车磨坊——如今已改成供两人入住的浪漫小屋——饱览整个庄园乃至更远处的全景。
findings.reason: “有些日子”常有“好一阵子”的意思（如“有些日子没见了”），用来说 On some days 容易误解，“有几天”更准确；“如今那里是一座……”是翻译腔的系动词句，“如今已改成……”说得更自然。

findings.current: 这里有一段100公里长的海岸线是全欧洲最壮美的
findings.proposed: 从阿连特茹延伸到阿尔加维的一段100公里长的海岸线是全欧洲最壮美的
findings.reason: [13] says the 100km of coastline runs from Porto Covo in the Alentejo to Burgau in the Algarve. 这里 (the Alentejo) puts the whole stretch in the Alentejo, which is inaccurate.

va.why: EN 'doesn't surprise me at all' = 一点也不意外; current reverses the meaning.
EN 'two weeks', not two months; the summary also says 两周.
EN says 28 years, not 18. 'No doubt' governs 'is buzzing' (a confident guess), so 想必热闹非凡 is the right reading. The holidaymakers clause is stated as fact.
'Neither is accurate' = both labels are wrong; current reverses it and clashes with sentence 8.
balmy = pleasantly warm; current gloss gives the opposite meaning, and the ZH itself says 和暖.
'has been dubbed' is a passive verb, so the POS should be v.

Per [13] the 100km runs from Porto Covo (Alentejo) to Burgau (Algarve), so 这里有一段 is inaccurate. The new cause clauses read clearly. Overlaps #9 and #18 on the same sentence; apply #6 and treat those as covered by it.
四五十年 means exactly '40 or 50 years' and is the normal Chinese way to give an approximate range.
Same fix as sentence 10; current text matches the summary.
Valid fix: 部分原因在于交通不便 supplies the missing 原因 and is accurate. It is superseded by #6, which rewrites the whole sentence; apply only one.
招牌地区 is an unnatural collocation. 'poster regions' = the regions that appear on tourism posters, which 常上宣传海报的地区 conveys. 这里的魅力 drops the stray 它. Meaning unchanged.
'gentle sands' next to 'shallow bay' means gently sloping sand, so 沙滩平缓 is more accurate than 沙滩柔和. The active 海边总会把我们吸引回去 keeps 'drawn back' and reads more naturally.
Same content, but the English appositive order (……之一——地名) is replaced with natural Chinese order: place name first, then the description.
'a matter of accessibility' (explained by the two-hour drive in brackets) = 交通不便; 部分原因在于 removes the 与否的问题 translationese with no loss of meaning.
为给 stacks two prepositions; 为渔民供应饭食而建 means the same thing and reads cleanly.
清澈碧绿的海水 is the natural order for the two adjectives 'clear turquoise'; meaning unchanged.

va.amended_proposed: 除了他们，那里空无一人——又是一处空荡荡的风景胜地；在这里，那一周里我已经是第一百次纳闷：这段原始纯净的海岸怎么至今仍如此鲜为人知？
va.why: The problem is real (awkward 我那一周已是第一百次). But the proposal's 站在这里 adds 'standing', which is not in the EN, and 我那一周里已经是 is still clumsy. 那一周里我已经是第一百次纳闷 reads better. 风景胜地 and the question mark are kept.

va.amended_proposed: 有几天，我们一路跋涉上坡，走到那座风车磨坊——如今已改成供两人入住的浪漫小屋——去饱览整个庄园乃至更远处的全景。
va.why: 有几天 and 如今已改成 are improvements. Keep 去 before 饱览, though: it carries the purpose in 'for panoramic views', which the proposal drops.
Correct: the coastline runs from the Alentejo into the Algarve, so 这里 is inaccurate. It is superseded by #6 (same sentence, fuller fix); apply only one.

vb.why: The current ZH reverses the negation in 'doesn't surprise me at all'. The proposed ZH is exact.
EN says 'two weeks', not two months, and the summary also says 两周.
The number is wrong: EN says 28 years, not 18. 'No doubt' applies to the restaurant being busy, so 想必 fits there and matches the gloss. The new sentence order reads naturally.
'Neither is accurate' means both are inaccurate. The current ZH reverses this and contradicts sentence 8.
The current gloss gives the opposite meaning. balmy means warm and pleasant, which matches 和暖 in the ZH.
'has been dubbed' is a passive verb, so the POS must be v., not n.

The current 这里 puts the whole coastline in the Alentejo, but sentence 13 says it runs to Burgau in the Algarve. The current clause 部分是…问题 also has no subject and garbles the cause. The proposal fixes both and stays exact. Accepting this one replaces 9 and 18.
Idiomatic Chinese writes an approximate pair of adjacent numbers as 四五十年. The meaning is identical.
Same fix as sentence 10. This edits a different part of the summary from 6, so the two do not clash.
Proposal 6 already covers this part of the summary, and 6 is accepted. Applying both would conflict.
招牌地区 is not a natural collocation, and the pronoun 它 is translationese. The proposal is a real improvement. 登上旅游海报 is more precise and more written in register than 上宣传海报.
vb.amended_proposed: 这片土地上有麦田、栓皮栎林、开满野花的草甸，还有一座座刷成白色的小村庄；比起法国、意大利那些常登上旅游海报的地区，这里的魅力更为含蓄。

vb.why: 沙滩柔和 is a wrong collocation. gentle sands here means a gently sloping beach (平缓), which pairs with 海湾水浅. The active phrasing also reads better than 被吸引回海边.
The current 位于…村庄之一——专名 pattern is standard, natural Chinese, common in journalism, and it is accurate. The change is a matter of taste.
交通便利与否的问题 is translationese for 'a matter of accessibility'. 部分原因在于交通不便 is idiomatic and exact, and the parenthesis explains it.
为给 stacks two prepositions and reads clumsily. 为渔民供应饭食而建 is smooth and keeps the same meaning.
清澈的碧绿海水 is an awkward modifier order. 清澈碧绿的海水 is the natural Chinese phrasing.

风景胜地 is the standard term and matches the gloss, while 美景胜地 is non-standard. 我那一周里已经是第一百次纳闷 follows the natural Chinese 'I + period + 已经是第N次' pattern. A question mark after the direct 怎么 question is fine.

有几天 avoids the 好一阵子 reading of 有些日子, and 如今已改成 conveys the 'now converted' sense better than the copular sentence. Keep 去 before 饱览 so the purpose (for the panoramic views) stays clearly linked across the dash.
vb.amended_proposed: 有几天，我们一路跋涉上坡，走到那座风车磨坊——如今已改成供两人入住的浪漫小屋——去饱览整个庄园乃至更远处的全景。

vb.why: The point is valid, but the accepted proposal 6 already fixes it with more precise wording. Applying both would conflict.
